opening.argument: The video presents a straightforward customer-support process for Samsung products: users can register a device in the Samsung Members App and request assistance. The on-screen steps show signing in, choosing Add to register a product, selecting Request Support, and describing the help needed. The description says a customer care agent will reach out with a solution. These are ordinary product-service actions, not a money-making offer or a request to join a financial scheme. The process is framed around getting assistance for a Samsung product, and the displayed support form reinforces that practical purpose.

citations.quote: For any assistance on your Samsung Products, all you’ve to do is to register your product and request support on the Samsung Members App.
